decision.summary: The Federal Reserve voted to hold the federal funds rate at 1 percent.

changes.quote: The probability of an unwelcome fall in inflation has diminished in recent months and now appears almost equal to that of a rise in inflation.
changes.explanation: The Fed feels less worried about the risk of deflation than it did previously.

changes.quote: With inflation quite low and resource use slack, the Committee believes that it can be patient in removing its policy accommodation.
changes.explanation: Because inflation is low and the economy still has unused capacity, the Fed is in no rush to raise rates.

tone_quotes.quote: The Committee perceives that the upside and downside risks to the attainment of sustainable growth for the next few quarters are roughly equal.
With inflation quite low and resource use slack, the Committee believes that it can be patient in removing its policy accommodation.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 12.47% APR costs about $51.96 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 4.22% and moved +11 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 5.66% would rise by about $20.93 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 5.7%, and employers added an average of 112k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 2% over the past year (December 2003); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 1.6%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 4.7% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved +17 bp on the day.

card.whats_next: The statement signals that the Fed intends to remain patient before making any changes to interest rates. Upcoming meetings will depend on how job growth and inflation evolve.

citations.detail: The Federal Open Market Committee decided today to keep its target for the federal funds rate at 1 percent.

llm_decision.summary: The Federal Reserve voted to hold the federal funds rate at 1 percent.
